info.cls_name: 人文藝術與社會經典教育
info.cls_ename: Humanities & arts and classical education of social science

description.describe_ch: 本課程除了使學生能熟悉台灣民間文化的基本內涵外，也要訓練學生如何向外國人介紹台灣文化。而台灣文化主要內容為： 台灣民間信仰；台灣民間宗教與台灣社會的互動；台灣民間信仰的神明與儀式與表演;臺灣食的文化 街頭技藝表演 茶文化與傳統節慶?此課程除了讓學生研究探索漢民族與原住民的傳統節慶之外，更讓學生理解到因應現代社會需求而衍生的新型態節慶，它幾乎每天都在台灣某個好山或好水的角落上演，使學生認識到傳統與現代的民俗信仰與文化不但豐富了台灣人的日常與文明生活，更儼然成為詮釋台灣文明的「超級程式」。本課程期待使學生體認到台灣人永遠都懷抱著一份彷若參加慶典的熱誠心意，面對在未來等著我們的無窮機會與希望。
description.describe_eh: The course is to acquaint students with the basic significance of Taiwanese cultures; in addition, it also aims to develop students’ abilities to introduce to foreigners Taiwanese various cultures. The Taiwanese folk cultures include Taiwanese folk beliefs, the interconnections between religious societies and religions, food cultures, or Taiwanese religious rituals, festivals and performances. We expect to make students realize that a rich and complex medley of traditional festivals celebrated by the indigenous and Chinese peoples of Taiwan forms an integral part of life on the island, with modernity having brought with it some new celebrations of its own. Every day, festivals are being held somewhere in Taiwan. Transcending ethnic barriers, these festivals imbue vitality and structure into people's lives and cultures and help them greet the future with unabashed enthusiasm and boundless hope.
